title: Unit 36 Consolidation: Civil Society and Local Communities, 2010–2026
grammar: Review: attribution, cause, proportion, contrast and concession
goal: I can summarise the teachers' protests, the local government finances, the battery factories and the EU debate between 2019 and 2026, with years and sources.
I can attribute, link causes, set views against each other and state concessions.
I can say when Hungary joined the European Union, who won the election of 12 April 2026 and who was elected prime minister.
